events.verdict: Gueye (ATL) establishes himself in Nesmith's (IND) path prior to the contact.
Nesmith (IND) legally contests Johnson's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Huff (IND) establishes himself in Alexander-Walker's (ATL) path prior to the contact.
Johnson (ATL) establishes himself in a legal defensive position in Nesmith's (IND) path prior to the body contact.
Nembhard (IND) legally contests Alexander-Walker's (ATL) jump shot attempt.
Huff (IND) uses his left arm to initiate brief contact to Alexander-Walker (ATL) during the screen. The contact is marginal and does not affect the play.
McCollum (ATL) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Nembhard (IND).
Nesmith (IND) brings his arm toward Johnson's (ATL) path and marginal contact occurs during Johnson's (ATL) drive.
Nesmith (IND) jumps alongside Johnson (ATL) and marginal body contact occurs during Johnson's (ATL) upward shooting motion.
Siakam (IND) brushes Daniels' (ATL) arm as he pursues the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
McCollum (ATL) brings his off-arm toward Mathurin's (IND) side and marginal contact occurs as McCollum (ATL) attempts to dribble around Mathurin (IND) during the drive.
Gueye (ATL) is already in Mathurin's (IND) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the screen.
Mathurin (IND) contests McCollum's (ATL) jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with their arm does not prevent them from following through.
Siakam (IND) makes marginal contact with Alexander-Walker's (ATL) after the pick on the perimeter.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) is in a legal defensive position during Siakam's (IND) drive and marginal body contact occurs as they come together.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) avoids making body contact with Siakam (IND) as he contests the jump shot attempt.
Nesmith (IND) is moving alongside Johnson's (ATL) path and absorbs the marginal contact that occurs during the drive.
Mathurin (IND) contests Gueye's (ATL) jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with their arm does not prevent them from following through.
Nembhard (IND) initiates contact with Alexander-Walker's (ATL) arm that affects his ability to secure the rebound.
McConnell (INC) inbounds the ball without leaving his designated throw in location.
After the steal, Alexander-Walker (ATL) delivers arm contact to McConnell (IND) as he attempts to push the ball in transition.
Gueye (ATL) initiates contact with Mathurin's (IND) arm, which affects his play at the basket.
Walker (IND) establishes, and maintains, a legal guarding position as he defends McCollum's (ATL) shot attempt.
